== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==

=== Missing data ===
* The interview gives no date, no interviewer and only the first name "Doug" for the designer, so he is not linked. [[Doug Taylor]] was on the design team then, but the page does not say so.
* The previews are described as the interview gives them; they are not matched to the released card titles.

== 15 July 2005 forum typing, 25 November 2026 ==
A 15 July 2005 typing of the full set texts by CRingwell, in the Players Committee forum topic "Virtual Set 7" (t=6359), was added to [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]] from the Internet Archive capture of 18 June 2006. The card texts themselves were not copied onto the set page; the capture is cited as a source. This is the pre-2009 set, not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 7]].
